af9.bus.module.tooltip.0: A Central Monitor module: shows the machines on the machine bus and sends them commands.
af9.bus.module.tooltip.1: Needs a Bus Connector in the monitor's wall, cabled with Optical Bus Cable to the machines' Bus Connectors.
af9.bus.module.tooltip.2: On Advanced Monitors, tap its buttons: start / stop, batch, the mode.
af9.bus_connector.tooltip.0: The machine bus's port: a machine's (one in a multiblock), a Central Monitor's (in its wall) or a Bus Controller's.
af9.bus_connector.tooltip.1: Optical Bus Cable plugs into its front face.
af9.bus_connector.tooltip.2: Its screen sets what it shares on the bus and which commands it takes.
af9.bus_connector.tooltip.3: Also a computation and optical data reception hatch: GT's Assembly Line, Research Station, Data Bank and Network Switch take it, and the machine draws CWU/t and research over the bus.
af9.bus.connector.label: Name
af9.bus.connector.no_machine: Not part of a machine yet
af9.bus.connector.alone: No other connector on the cable
af9.bus.connector.overloaded: Overloaded: more than %1$s machines on this bus. It carries no computation, research or supplies until it has %1$s or fewer; split it.
af9.bus.connector.monitor_hint: Put a Machine Bus Module into a monitor group of this Central Monitor.
af9.bus.connector.hint: Click to switch. The name is how the monitors list this machine.
af9.bus.connector.sources: Computation up to %s CWU/t (a bus carries %s at most) from %s hatches, research from %s sources
af9.bus.connector.controller: A Bus Controller may set this machine's recipe and supply it
af9.bus.connector.recipe: Recipe set by a Bus Controller: %s
af9.bus_controller.tooltip.0: The machine bus's PLC: runs up to 4 buses (a Bus Connector on each) and picks a recipe for each machine on them.
af9.bus_controller.tooltip.1: Takes items and fluids through input buses and hatches, ME ones too (AE2 sends it the ingredients).
af9.bus_controller.tooltip.2: Once a second it puts one run of ingredients into a machine's own input bus when it holds none; the products stay in the machine.
af9.bus_controller.tooltip.3: Its Interconnect Hatch links it to other Bus Controllers: one network sharing computation, research, machines and inputs. Draws 120 EU/t while on.
af9.interconnect_hatch.tooltip.0: A Bus Controller's link to other Bus Controllers.
af9.interconnect_hatch.tooltip.1: Optical Bus Cable plugs into its front face; every Interconnect Hatch on one run of cable links its controller to the others.
af9.interconnect_hatch.tooltip.2: Linked controllers are one network: computation and research flow between their buses, and each supplies from its own inputs first, then the others'.
af9.bus.interconnect.no_controller: Not part of a Bus Controller yet
af9.bus.interconnect.alone: No other Interconnect Hatch on the cable
af9.bus.interconnect.hint: Only Interconnect Hatches talk to each other: Bus Connectors on the same cable do not see this one.

af9.me_link.from_gt: Computation straight from %s block(s) against it (a CWU Server, a Computation Transmitter Hatch, Optical Fiber Cable)
af9.me_link.from_nothing: Nothing to draw from: put Optical Bus Cable, a CWU Server, a Computation Transmitter Hatch or Optical Fiber Cable against any face
af9.me_link.off: ME networks need no computation (switched off in af9-common.toml)
af9.me_link.no_controller: No ME Controller on this network: it needs no computation
af9.me_link.network: ME network: %s channels need %s CWU/t (1 CWU/t per %s channels); it gets %s CWU/t
af9.me_link.short: Short of computation: only %s of %s channels (the devices farthest from the controller go without)
af9.me_link.controller_tooltip: AF9: its network needs computation, 1 CWU/t per %s channels, through an ME Computation Link
af9.cwu_server.tooltip.0: Turns EU into computation: up to %s CWU/t
af9.cwu_server.tooltip.1: At full output %s EU/t (one amp of its tier); less when less is drawn
af9.cwu_server.tooltip.2: Feeds an ME Computation Link against it, GT Optical Fiber Cable, or the machine bus (Optical Bus Cable on any side but the front)
af9.cwu_server.power: %s EU per CWU (%s EU/t at full output)
af9.cwu_server.hint: Power goes in on any side but the front (its lights). Optical Bus Cable on any side but the front feeds the bus; an ME Computation Link or GT fibre can take it on any side.

af9.scanner.hint.15: Not enough air cooling: add Air Conditioning Hatches (the CU must reach the node's heat load).

af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.0: Cools a Photolithography Line or Scanner with air.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.1: 1 cooling unit at MV, doubling per tier. A print needs 1 (350 nm) to 16 (65 nm) units; two hatches fit.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.2: Draws a quarter of an amp of its tier while a print runs. Every doubling above the heat load: prints 10% faster, 20% fewer broken wafers.
af9.air_conditioning_hatch.tooltip.3: The warm air leaves from the front: keep it clear.
